name: key-path flattening with wildcards
mechanism: flatten a structured term to a path of keys in which positions declared irrelevant become wildcards, so that retrieval by path finds every stored pattern that could match the term
requires: a trie or equivalent keyed store
fails_when: a pattern whose root reduces to a wildcard matches everything
index-time and lookup-time reduction settings must agree or matches are silently lost
